responsibilities: Build the end-to-end tracking pipeline for our Visa card program integrated into UpTrader CRM.
Monitor the full card adoption funnel: Trading Profit Milestone - Card Application - Issuance - Wallet Tokenization (Apple Pay / Google Pay) - First POS Spend.

Model cardholder unit economics: spend velocity, ATM vs. POS volume, interchange revenue, and the direct correlation between card ownership and trader retention (validating our 2.4x LTV expansion benchmark).
Audit, maintain, and enhance tracking across our custom frontend authorization and registration forms (which interface with our UpTrader CRM backend).
Maintain clean dataLayer event structures, custom JavaScript variables, and trigger logic within Google Tag Manager.
Ensure zero attribution loss and accurate parameter forwarding (ClickID, SubID, UTM, device fingerprints) from initial ad click to CRM account creation.
Collaborate directly with our in-house media buyers (Google Search, Meta, TikTok) to prepare, QA, and validate tracking environments before major campaign launches.
Deploy and monitor server-side tracking pipelines: Meta Conversions API (CAPI), TikTok Events API, and Google Enhanced Conversions.
Implement offline conversion feedback loops to train ad platform algorithms on verified KYC, funded accounts (FTDs), and card activations rather than shallow lead registrations.
Build and maintain the unified data models in our ClickHouse DWH connecting:- Auth0 SSO (Web & Mobile App Authentication)
Design, automate, and maintain operational and executive dashboards covering:- Full Funnel Dynamics: Impressions - Clicks - Regs - SumSub KYC - Account Creation - FTD - Card Order.

Configure event pipelines and webhooks to trigger automated behavioral funnels (e.g., registrations stalled without deposit for 24h, trading profit generated - card activation prompt, card issued but unused for 5 days)
